scenario: Bit-for-bit replay determinism per LCON.2.1 — the compiled rule set is an input to the determinism guarantee. Pin: a rule with `now()` (the only non-deterministic input in expressions) compiles cleanly — the engine drives it from the recorded clock, not wall time.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    ts: Time

rule r:
    Event e where now() - e.ts > 1_s
->
    log info "stale"
